title: Cloud Readiness Scan
lead: An assessment of an organisation's technical, organisational and financial readiness to migrate workloads to the cloud.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: The Cloud Readiness Scan evaluates how prepared an organisation is for cloud migration — across its application portfolio, IT organisation, security posture, financial model and skills. The output is a workload disposition map (migrate, modernise, retire, retain) and a readiness improvement plan.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: Cloud readiness is a prerequisite assessment in cloud transformation use cases. In ITOM, it informs the platform strategy and the operating model changes needed to support a cloud-first environment — including new roles (cloud engineers, FinOps), processes (release management, cloud governance) and tools.

items.desc: Application inventory, dependencies and cloud suitability (6Rs framework).
Data residency, regulatory requirements and security controls.
Current cloud capabilities and skill gaps in the IT team.
OpEx vs CapEx model readiness and cloud cost management.
Monitoring, DevOps maturity and automation baseline.
